title: Golden deer
topic: Aranya Kanda — Maricha as the deer; the false cry
disclaimer: Ashram must match ep01. Cry in Rama's voice is supported tradition, labeled in caption if needed. Deer: slightly wrong gold.
story_goal: Sita wants the deer; Rama hunts; Maricha's dying cry in Rama's voice.
framework_goal: Magic/creature + off-screen voice; Sita + ashram lock from ep 1.
gate: Deer design locked; ashram matches ep 1; cry is labeled dramatized as performance of a supported beat.
narrative_summary: The forest offers a gold that does not belong. Rama leaves. A voice that is his, and is not, calls them apart.

lighting_recipe.shadow: long, plus unnatural gold bounce off the deer

fact_checks.claim: Maricha as golden deer; dying cry in Rama's voice.

panels.scene_description: Ashram as ep01-p01: hut left, same trees. Household at rest.
panels.caption: The house has not moved. The war has.

shot_card.camera: wide, match ep01-p01 as closely as boards will allow

panels.scene_description: Golden deer at the clearing edge. Too perfect. Joints slightly wrong.
panels.caption: Gold that does not belong in Dandaka.

shot_card.lighting: self-luminous gold vs natural west key
shot_card.blocking: deer in the open, ashram tiny

panels.scene_description: Sita sees it. Want is real, not stupid-girl. Rama already does not like the gold.
panels.dialogue:
SITA: I want that living thing.
RAMA: Living things that shine like metal are not gifts.

panels.scene_description: Rama takes the bow. Lakshmana is told to stay.
panels.dialogue:
RAMA: Hold the door.
LAKSHMANA: I am not a door.

panels.scene_description: Hunt among trees. Arrow. The gold breaks.
Maricha dying, half deer half man if needed, or deer with a man's fear in the eye. Mouth open.
panels.caption: The cry is his work. The voice is stolen.

panels.scene_description: Ashram: the stolen voice hits them. Sita is already moving.

shot_card.camera: two-shot doorway, match ep01 doorway language

panels.scene_description: Rama in the forest, hearing his own voice that he did not speak. Too late.
panels.caption: He understands the trick while the house is already emptying.
